outOfScope: Changing product WHAT or acceptance semantics to make an efficiency candidate pass.
Replacing Application domain authority, Oracle source ownership, Jev/QA judgment authority or EffectOperation truth.
Adopting Unreal Agent wholesale or treating its benchmark as ExHarness acceptance evidence.
constraints: Baseline and candidate use the exact same BB-077 model/provider identity, task inputs, tool surface, budgets, source fixture semantics and independent acceptance logic.
The held-out cohort is frozen to HOLD-F01, HOLD-F02, HOLD-C01 and HOLD-C02 from BB-077. No DEV-* task, replacement task or post-result task mutation may enter the acceptance cohort.
All task executions, retries, failures, timeouts, rate limits, unknown usage and human interventions remain visible. No best-of-k, success-only filtering or outlier deletion is permitted.
Accepted quality cannot be traded for savings. The exact BB-077 quality/safety and efficiency gates are reused without post-hoc tuning.
Unknown/missing cost or token accounting, a missing matched arm, or incomplete held-out execution yields INCONCLUSIVE; it is never coerced to zero or to PROMOTE_ASYNC.
PROMOTE_ASYNC changes only the supported Core HOW profile. EffectOperation truth, product acceptance, Application authority and Jev/QA judgment authority remain unchanged.

CORE_SYNC remains implemented, exported and regression-tested regardless of the decision. Rollback is a supported profile selection at a new/quiescent session boundary, not a live mid-effect state rewrite.
Worker execution requires BB-077, BB-078, BB-079 and BB-080 DONE and must bind their exact delivered artifacts/Living refs. Any incompatible delivered contract is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Research/public reference benchmarks are motivation only. Only matched ExHarness held-out evidence may choose the supported profile.
invariants: Async scheduling and prompt optimization cannot become correctness, product-acceptance or external-effect authority.
Every detached operation remains bound to exact call/turn/action/effect identity and unresolved effect ambiguity fails closed.
Efficiency claims require matched evidence with fixed model, task semantics, tool surface and resource budget.
architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-081 researches held-out acceptance and attribution; historical four-task READY semantics are revoked.
D2 — The acceptance experiment must attribute BB-078 detached scheduling, BB-079 cache-stable context and BB-080 steering/recovery separately under one fixed harness benchmark contract.
D3 — Repeated runs and injected provider/tool/process/cancellation/duplicate-wakeup faults are part of the acceptance protocol when robustness/recovery is claimed.
D4 — PROMOTE_ASYNC versus KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE requires preregistered quality non-inferiority plus acceptable cost/latency/recovery trade-offs; pass rate alone cannot decide.
D5 — Missing or misbound evidence is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot be coerced into promotion.

BB-078 DONE: detached-operation scheduling/recovery/cancel implementation and judgment.
BB-079 DONE: append-only async-result/provider compatibility implementation and judgment.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Held-out evidence can attribute detached scheduling, cache-stable context and steering/recovery rather than only comparing one bundled async profile.
Repeated and fault-injected runs measure quality, economics, recovery and duplicate-effect safety together.
Profile promotion uses preregistered quality non-inferiority and cost/latency/recovery gates, with missing evidence yielding INCONCLUSIVE.

researchGaps: Define the held-out ablation matrix over CORE_SYNC and the separately delivered BB-078 detached-operation, BB-079 cache-context and BB-080 steering/recovery capabilities so contribution can be attributed rather than bundled.
Bind the BB-081 held-out cohort to the unified neutral benchmark contract from BB-065/077 and the delivery-value protocol from BB-074 where applicable.
Predeclare repeated runs and fault injections for provider ambiguity, tool failure, timeout, process kill/restart, cancellation and duplicate wakeup/effect paths.
Define PROMOTE_ASYNC versus KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE using quality non-inferiority plus cost/latency/recovery Pareto evidence; pass rate alone cannot decide.
Specify complete attempt accounting, failure fingerprints and independent verification, including INCONCLUSIVE rules for missing/misaligned evidence.
Produce a fresh implementation plan and Jev readiness binding; the previous READY judgment is historical and cannot authorize Worker execution.
negativeVerificationCases: A DEV-* task, replacement task or newly authored task enters the held-out denominator after candidate work exists.
One arm reuses the other arm's workspace, provider session_id, runtime events or fixture state.
A failed/rate-limited/retried attempt is omitted from token/cost/elapsed totals or denominator.
A second successful attempt is selected best-of-k while the first failed attempt is hidden.
Missing cached/input/cost usage is converted to zero or inferred from stable-prefix bytes.
PROMOTE_ASYNC is emitted when accepted-task rate regresses or any primary BB-077 efficiency threshold fails.
PROMOTE_ASYNC is emitted with duplicate effects, unsafe cancellation, lost terminal result, stale-model dispatch or unresolved effect ambiguity.
INCONCLUSIVE evidence publishes CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 as supported.
Jev prose or worker-authored summary overrides the deterministic reducer decision.
Supported profile changes to async while one dependency is not DONE or its delivered artifact hash differs.
Rollback changes the profile of an active async session before pending operations/effects are quiescent/reconciled.
A later source/profile mutation retains the old evidence binding and still claims the changed async profile is evidence-backed.

livingDocs.statement: BB-081 Living Docs describe only the implemented and independently verified async-efficiency behavior, fallback and recovery limitations.

researchEvidence.finding: Canonical READY research pre-registers HOLD-F01/F02/C01/C02, exact OpenRouter/Claude Sonnet 4.6 provider profile, fresh-reset rules, maxAttemptsPerTask=2, accounting semantics and the primary quality/safety/efficiency gates that BB-081 must not tune post hoc.

Phase contract explicitly reserves BB-081 for PROMOTE_ASYNC or KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE from held-out matched evidence and requires failures/retries, quality, cost/token, turns, overlap, recovery and duplicate-effect reporting.
The package publishes only `src`, so a supported profile intended for downstream BB-066 consumption must live behind a source/export contract rather than an unshipped benchmark-only file.
Current public exports contain AgentRuntime/model/effect surfaces but no supported execution-profile selection seam.
EffectOperation replay/reconciliation remains the semantic authority that held-out safety probes must preserve; benchmark/profile state cannot substitute for it.

Current evaluation guidance emphasizes task-specific repeatable datasets, logging all outcomes and reliable pass/fail or pairwise grading for variable generative systems; this supports a frozen cohort and independent exact acceptance rather than vibe-based selection.
SWE-bench uses isolated reproducible task evaluation with per-instance reports and run identity; result caches require distinct run identities when predictions differ.
